verdict.rationale: GitHub Copilot docs explicitly describe cloud and local sandboxes as isolated execution environments for agent actions (docs-16), which directly supports safe testing without touching production, and automations/cloud agents run in these isolated environments (docs-15). However, there is no explicit documentation about connecting sandboxes to separate 'non-production' data sets or test-data provisioning, and no independent/hands-on verification of sandbox isolation guarantees. Missing for 10: explicit guidance on avoiding production data access, independent verification of sandbox isolation, and details on data separation between sandbox and production environments.
